indicator_name: Spread of Kazakhstan MinFin USD Eurobonds over US Treasuries, by issue, end of month
description: Спред долларовых еврооблигаций Минфина РК к UST, по выпускам, конец месяца
methodology: YTM minus the FRED constant-maturity Treasury yield (DGS1/2/3/5/7/10/20/30) on the valuation date, linearly interpolated at the remaining maturity. USD bonds with at least a year to maturity. The 2024 and 2025 bonds are unreliable from 2022-04 (near-zero, then negative spreads 2023-04..2024-04; config/source_issues.yaml).
